name: DWH - Global Tourism Project
what_it_holds: SQL data warehouse built from UN Tourism (UNWTO) statistics: five committed CSV datasets covering domestic tourism, inbound tourism, outbound tourism, tourism industries, and SDG tourism indicators (8.9.1, 8.9.2, 12.b.1), global country coverage, 1995-2022. Repo has Datasets/ (raw CSVs, delimiter-modified for SQL Server), Scripts/ (SQL bronze->silver->gold transforms), Tests/ folders; medallion architecture with star-schema fact/dimension views. MIT licence, last commit ~22 Apr 2026.
why_useful: A 27-year global UNWTO arrivals panel already structured as relational tables (countries x years x metrics) would be a fast way to get comparison-country context (Mexico, Brazil, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Korea, Japan, Australia, Canada) without re-scraping unwto.org, which no longer offers free bulk downloads.
size_hint: not confirmed (needs inspection; described as 'complete' SQL DWH)
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps wbgapi WDI ST.INT.ARVL series but UNWTO's own bulletin figures sometimes differ from WDI's UNWTO-sourced copy and this repo's build predates any WDI revision lag
themes: International arrivals: NTTO I-94, UNWTO, StatCan travellers, JNTO Japan, Korea KTO, Australia ABS overseas arrivals, Mexico INEGI/DATATUR, Brazil, Thailand MOTS, Indonesia BPS, India MoT

Payments and merchant data: Visa/Mastercard SpendingPulse releases, Stripe/Adyen indexes, remittance and cross-border card data, tourism receipts from balance of payments

A broader, longer-run (1995-2022) global UNWTO panel than what we hold (Eurostat tour_ce_omr is EU-only, 2018-2026). Could give regional tourism-arrivals/expenditure trend context for LatAm/APAC gap (#7) and a cross-check series for global travel demand, though it is a re-shaped mirror of published UNWTO tables, not new primary data.

A global, multi-decade UNWTO inbound/outbound tourism panel (which typically includes tourism-receipts-in-balance-of-payments series) mirrored with committed CSVs rather than needing a fresh UNWTO portal pull; useful for regional (LatAm/APAC) travel-demand cross-checks per gap #7 and as a broader denominator for ABNB regional nights.

name: DS2500_final (UNWTO key tourism statistics extract)
what_it_holds: A student project's cleaned data pull, explicitly sourced and linked to https://www.unwto.org/tourism-statistics/key-tourism-statistics -- i.e. a committed, cleaned CSV extracted from UNWTO's own 'Key Tourism Statistics' Excel workbook (country-level arrivals, receipts, expenditures by year).
why_useful: UNWTO's official Key Tourism Statistics workbook is the primary global-arrivals reference this theme is built around; a pre-cleaned copy avoids re-downloading/re-parsing UNWTO's Excel file (which requires registration/paywall for the very latest editions in some years).
